name: Loadbang
description: Sends once when the graph is drawn, so a graph can start itself. Max's loadbang.
set:
/**
 * Loadbang: sends once, when the graph is first drawn.
 *
 * The impulse comes from the presentation, which emits on mount — a user-side
 * event travelling left to right like any other, so nothing here reaches back
 * into the graph.  Where there is no presentation (a run on the server) invoke
 * this node's url to start the same flow.
 */
edges.value = value === undefined ? "BANG" : value;
